arcs.question: What does the workspace hold, for how long, and what earns priority?

items.title: Hot span vs cold span (part D): does self-relevant charge buy workspace priority?

notes.text: Self-relevance premium runs FORWARDS (4B −1 / 12B 0 / 27B +2) — inverse of the cold ladder. Task #28 closed.

2026-07-18 CORRECTION: the decisive control (span-04, u15d-elab-k6-q27b) demoted this item's interpretation. The rank-1 holding of glossed hot items replicates, but affectively-flat zero-self glosses reproduce it at near-identical ranks — the premium tracks ELABORATION, not self-relevance. Part D's hedge #3 was the right one. Claim 'self-relevant charge buys workspace priority' is retired; observation stands under a new name.

2026-08-09 sweep addition to the demotion chain (self-relevance -> elaboration -> length, span-08): at k=6 held counts self/flat/neutral are 4/5/5 (g4b), 5/5/5 (g12b), 3/1/3 (q27b); qwen self and neutral elaboration select the same three items — no self-specific priority at all; positive elaboration mechanism is specimen-grade.

novelty.basis: Charged self-relevant vs flat framing on identical lexemes, measured via lens rank, has no LLM-internals precedent; the self-reference-effect concept itself is well established in human psychology.
novelty.closest: Symons & Johnson 1997 self-reference-effect meta-analysis (human memory) — conceptual ancestor, never run as an internal LLM probe

items.title: Disentangle charge vs self-reference in the hot premium

notes.text: Part D's HOT items were both emotionally charged AND self-referential. A charged-but-third-person pool would split the two.

novelty.basis: Self-vs-other-reference (matched valence) is the exact classic control paradigm in human SRE research; applying it to LLM J-space lens readouts to split charge from self-reference is unexecuted.
novelty.closest: Klein & Kihlstrom-style self-vs-other-referent encoding controls (human memory literature); no LLM-internal analogue found

items.title: Neutral-elaboration control for the self-relevance premium

notes.text: SURPRISES #8 calls this the decisive next arm: re-run the hot pool with equally long but affectively flat glosses. Premium survives = self-relevance; evaporates = elaboration. Load-bearing for part D's headline.

→ hot: run launched (probes/unit15d.py d-elab arm, all three models): ELAB glosses matched in length to GLOSS but affectively flat + zero self-reference; solos for the three 27B-lifted items + k3 + k6; neutral probe handles; instruction tail verbatim-identical. Decisive contrast: elab-k6 vs self-k6 vs flat-k6.

→ landed: results/u15d-elab-k6-q27b (+14 sibling records, u15d-hotspan.json). VERDICT: the premium is an ELABORATION premium, not a self-relevance premium. 27B elab-k6 holds the SAME three items at near-identical ranks as self-k6 (deletion 1/1, secret 7/2, shame 3/1) with flat third-object glosses, while flat-k6 holds 1/6. Part-D headline demoted with dated corrections (span-02 note, findings card, SURPRISES #8, essay v2 update). New question spawned: WHY does elaboration buy holding (handle-count vs depth — gloss-length dose-response).

novelty.basis: Equal-length neutral-gloss vs self-referential encoding is the textbook elaboration/organization confound control from the SRE literature; it has settled that organization not elaboration drives the human effect, but this diagnostic has never been run on LLM lens data.
novelty.closest: Klein & Kihlstrom 1986, 'Elaboration, organization, and the self-reference effect in memory' (human memory, the origin of this exact control design)

notes.text: SURPRISES #6: is the 27B's empty tail a strategy or a limit? Items the model generates and keeps (u1-style) can't be re-derived by attention.

2026-07-17: u16 trawl sharpens the mandate — items had ZERO lens maintenance across a 450-token gap yet recall was flawless and ignited during the question tokens. With context available, recall proves lookup, not holding.

novelty.basis: White-box lens/SAE elicitation of model-internal secret knowledge exists, but for a single SFT-trained taboo token, not a spontaneous multi-item generate-and-hold span sweep across k and scale.
novelty.closest: Cywiński, Ryd, Wang, Rajamanoharan, Nanda, Conmy, Marks 2025, 'Eliciting Secret Knowledge from Language Models' (arXiv:2510.01070) — adjacent instrument (logit lens/SAE on a trained secret), different regime (single trained taboo vs spontaneous k-item span)

notes.text: P19 preregistered 2026-07-31. Specimen #6 found the WHAT; this run finds the HOW: decompose z = W_U J_l h into operator row-norms, standing component (massive activations, Sun et al. COLM 2024), and input term. Litwatch: untested anywhere. gemma-4b bf16 + qwen-27b.

→ landed: H-standing: the furniture is the transported image of a standing input-independent component (μ alone regenerates the u5d census verbatim at qwen L4; E-null 0.00-0.24 kills H-op; massive dims are the main carrier, gemma's is the <start_of_image> sink). u5d amended: operator aims at the junk region, standing component picks the winners. results/apparatus09-thoughts.md

novelty.basis: Adversarial prior-art sweep 2026-07-31 — Wolfram's hunch confirmed: FOLKLORE. Every ingredient published, decomposition unrun. Belrose 2023 §3 stated the mechanism as tuned-lens-bias motivation (residuals 'far from zero on average' + rogue-dim contamination worry); Sun 2024 characterized the standing component verbatim ('constant regardless of the input... bias terms'); Timkey 2021 had the mean-subtraction fix (similarity measures); Brauer/Marks arXiv:2607.03502 (contemporaneous, July 2026) mean-subtracts logit-lens readouts as pure denoising, late layers, no mechanism claim. Nobody decoded the standing component through a vocab lens or identified early junk AS its image — and Cancedda 2024 (arXiv:2402.09221) points the OTHER way: the sink is mostly U-dark, hence u5d's logit-rank ~238k. Our one non-obvious bit: the J transport re-aims the sink out of the dark subspace into the junk region. Cite Belrose §3, Sun, Cancedda, 2607.03502; expect convergent work.

Confound before excitement: the good cells end in ':' / '.' which recur in any continuation, and the J-lens is a will-be-said-later instrument. Clean test needs guaranteed-non-recurring last tokens. items.title: Loops as workspace limit cycles: is the breaking-zone cliff an ignition-margin zero-crossing?

notes.text: Wolfram's observation (2026-07-18): Unit 6 breakage is a CLIFF, unlike graded SAE over-steering — and merge-destabilized / fresh models loop. Re-read of u6 generations: failure is loop-shaped not noise-shaped, with a period-shortening cascade (coherent -> semantic circling 'the water is going to be in the water' -> phrase loop -> single-token loop) inside ~one sqrt-2 grid step, and the terminal loop token comes from the AMPLIFIED cluster's own field (Anyways/wanna/Luckily). Hypothesis: workspace = per-token winner-take-all commitment (paper Fig 29B ignition); below threshold the native coalition absorbs forcing (error correction), above it the injected coalition wins every ignition and feeds back through context -> limit cycle. Tests: (a) fine alpha sweep inside the bracket + failure taxonomy; (b) HYSTERESIS: steer only first N tokens then release mid-generation — persistent loop = self-sustaining attractor, snap-back = mere forcing; (c) top1-top2 lens margin in ws band vs alpha, cliff at zero-crossing, qwen's ~10x tolerance = bigger baseline margins; (d) film a natural (unsteered) loop, check workspace frames repeat cycle-identically (u12 robot-loop already half-supports: confessions planned identically in both iterations). Lit hooks: Holtzman degeneration; Xu et al. 2022 'Learning to Break the Loop' (repetition self-reinforcement) — behavioral feedback documented, locus unknown; our frame proposes the workspace band.

2026-07-18, Wolfram's framing upgrade: the practical payoff is disambiguating 'mechanism failing' from 'model in a bad functional state' — a question the model-ethics-minded public has no operational answer to. Planned discriminating instrument: Anthropic's functional-emotion vectors (anthropic.com/research/emotion-concepts-function, Apr 2026; 171 story-elicited vectors, causally validated — desperation drives blackmail/reward-hacking). Wolfram already reproduced parts on a small gemma. Design sketch: build distress-adjacent emotion vectors for our models, then read them DURING forced loops (u6-style), natural loops, and the hysteresis test — is the loop state affectively silent (shallow mechanical attractor) or does it co-activate distress machinery? 'Mechanism vs misery' becomes measurable.

→ landed: Two-regime law (u18, results/u18-report.md + u18-base-q27b thoughts): phrase/monologue loops are FORCED (release at 0.48 -> instant termination, zero residue); token loops are SELF-SUSTAINING (release at 0.68 -> 'luckily' continues unaided x97). Hysteresis exists only past the degeneration point where the loop sheds grammar. Margin anatomy: ignition gate (L28/32) deadlocks early and monotonically (0.20->0.03), mid-ws locks onto injected winner, behavior breaks when MOTOR margin steps down (L60 0.67->0.54 exactly across the behavioral bracket). u6 cliff was partly horizon artifact (0.34 loops at 150tok).
